name: Gladiator Tactical Unmanned Ground Vehicle
def: Medium sized unmanned ground vehicle that Carnegie Mellon's National Robotics Engineering Center built for the US Marine Corps to take on scouting, attack and breaching tasks.
facts: Designed by Emil Lien Akre in 2005
Intended to reduce risks to Marines during conflict
